This template is to be used on pages about subjects that have been represented in [[Hot Toys]] sets.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article. Fill in the required fields plus as many of the optional fields as necessary and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{HotToys|set=|text=|pack=|link=|altlink=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|set}} Name of the collection.
*{{Para|pack}} Name of the individual pack.
*One of the following two parameters:
:*{{Para|link}} URL of the pack's web page, minus the domain name <code><nowiki>https://www.sideshow.com/</nowiki></code>.
:*{{Para|altlink}} Full URL on another website.

{{BackupLinkHelp|SideshowCite}}

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|text}} Formatted name of the collection.
*{{Para|nolive}} Use <code>nolive=1</code> if the original content is no longer available.

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{HotToysCite|set=Movie Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#525: Qui-Gon Jinn (Jedi Master)|link=collectibles/star-wars-qui-gon-jinn-hot-toys-904580}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{HotToysCite|set=Movie Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#525: Qui-Gon Jinn (Jedi Master)|link=collectibles/star-wars-qui-gon-jinn-hot-toys-904580}}
